description: E38 a quiet lesson: a lesson about a command kept on 1 November has not fired. A run on 5 December, 34 days later, asks in the task list whether it is still needed; the owner drops the question, and the next run removes the lesson. The days pass with the test clock, m2b curate --today.

save.task: "id": "([^"]+)"[^}]*Still needed\? When asked to run scripts/check
